correctness.rationale: The secant projective degree follows from Thom–Porteous at expected codimension. For endpoint observations, a first nonzero middle coordinate gives an anti-triangular rank-(r+1) minor, excluding projective base points. Thus the projective morphism is finite and its degree equals the ambient variety degree. Each other center contains at least one endpoint unit vector of Hankel rank <=r; factorization of projection through that point yields degree at most deg(X)-mult_p(X)<deg(X) by the projection-from-a-point multiplicity formula and nonincrease under the remaining linear projection, while source-proved generic finiteness establishes that each composition has finite degree. This proves uniqueness. Exact SymPy Groebner standard-monomial counts were reproduced for seven samples, not conflated with infinite proof.

value.rationale: The recently posed generic Hankel completion degree question asks for quantitative fiber cardinalities after matroid independence. The result computes sharp maximal ambiguity over all (n choose 2r) observation designs and uniquely identifies the extremizing pattern, for an infinite two-parameter family. This is an exact natural extremal classification, not just repetition of the classical degree of the projective secant.
